source_ref.title_or_campaign: 토스증권 — 주식 투자를 쉽게 보는 세상으로 (Make Stock Investing Easy To See)
source_ref.product: 토스증권 주식 투자 앱·웹 (Toss Securities stock investing app and web)
source_ref.production_note: 30s fast-cut fintech brand film. A wordplay campaign built on the Korean idiom 쉽게 보다 (to take lightly / to see easily). A recurring bespectacled young everyman protagonist appears across many everyday vignettes (diner with a friend, design studio, taxi back seat, rooftop cafe as a waiter, bookstore) where authority figures and a famous investing book titled 주식투자 쉽게 보지 마라 (Don't Take Stock Investing Lightly) insist that 주식 투자 쉽게 보면 안 된다 (you must not take stock investing lightly). The protagonist flips the idiom: 근데 쉽게 보면 왜 안 돼요? / 쉽게 봐도 괜찮아요 — at Toss Securities you CAN see it easily. A rapid product montage of laptop/desktop/phone/tablet Toss Securities UI with kinetic typography 쉽게 / 넓게 / 깊게 (easily / widely / deeply) builds to the tagline 누구나 주식 투자를 쉽게 보는 세상으로 (Into a world where everyone sees stock investing easily) and the 토스증권 logo endcard. Brand blue ~#3182F6. On-screen legal disclaimers run along the lower edge throughout.

target_demo: Korean adults 20s-40s, retail-investing curious beginners who find stocks intimidating, mobile-native

production_signature.signature_note: Warm naturalistic cinematography with shallow depth of field across relatable Korean everyday locations, intercut with crisp Toss Securities device screens (laptop, desktop monitor, smartphone, tablet). Signature recurring extreme close-ups of the protagonist's eyes behind round glasses with the UI reflected in the lens. Kinetic white bold-sans typography (쉽게 / 넓게 / 깊게) is VO-synced and persists across multiple visual cuts. Persistent lower-edge legal disclaimer ticker. Brand blue accent reserved for the endcard logo.

global_layout.layout_note: Dialogue-driven vignettes use centered or thirds-based human framing; the product montage uses device screens whose own whitespace holds large kinetic Korean type lower-left. The rebuttal line splits across the frame (쉽게 보면 left / 왜 안 돼요? right). A thin legal disclaimer line is pinned to the lower edge in nearly every shot.

copywriting.tagline_text: 누구나 주식 투자를 쉽게 보는 세상으로
copywriting.copy_strategy: idiom_reversal — the campaign weaponizes the double meaning of 쉽게 보다 (to underestimate vs to see/understand easily). Antagonist voices and a book title repeat 쉽게 보면 안 된다 (don't take it lightly); the protagonist rebuts 쉽게 봐도 괜찮아요 (it's fine to see it easily) because Toss Securities makes hard info easy/wide/deep. Resolves to an inclusive world-vision tagline.
